description: Read or change how Popular Demand checks, before asking sellers to quote, that the user still wants a Request (one question, "Still want ...?", via get_request_questions). check_frequency: adaptive, weekly or monthly (at most), or never (only you are asked). check_channels: agent_then_email (email after 24 hours unanswered), agent_only or email_only. deal_alerts: whether the user is emailed new Offers for this Request (your notices are unaffected). No change fields: a read. A change needs user_confirmed and request_key; account settings need an agent with every Request in scope.

check_channels.description: Who asks: you, then email; only you; or only email.

check_frequency.description: How often the user is asked if they still want it.

deal_alerts.description: Whether the user is emailed new Offers for this Request.

request_key.description: Your key for this change; the same key repeats it safely.

user_confirmed.description: True: the user said yes to this exact change.
